# SM Marketing Group

> Sinead Murphy is a Dublin based fractional CMO for founder led brands in Ireland. She finds where a brand's sales are stalling, in its customers' own words, then either leads the fix with the founder or leaves a plan the team can run. Ten years as Marketing Director at Liffey Valley Shopping Centre.

## Who she is

Sinead Murphy has twenty years of marketing experience for Irish consumer brands across retail, aviation and telecoms. For ten years she was Marketing Director at Liffey Valley Shopping Centre, working with the team at Hines. She started SM Marketing Group in 2026. She is based in Foxrock, South County Dublin, and meets clients in person.

Earlier roles: Head of Marketing and Sales at Aer Lingus Regional and Stobart Air (2011 to 2016); Retail Marketing Lead at eircom for the launch of eMobile (2009 to 2011).
Education: Level 9 Professional Diploma in Innovation for Sustainability, University College Dublin (2024); Postgraduate Diploma in Digital Marketing Strategy, Dublin Business School; Professional Postgraduate Diploma in Marketing, Sales and PR, Dublin Business School; BA in English and Sociology, University College Dublin.

## What she does

- Fractional CMO: senior marketing leadership part time, without the cost of a full time hire. Three levels of support: Counsel, Lead and Growth. Fees are agreed on a call.
- The Diagnostic: a fixed fee piece of work that finds where sales are stalling across three stages, Seen, Sure and Sold. It ends with a written report, a 90 day priority plan and a readout. Fee agreed on a call.
- Who it is for: founder led brands, mostly those that trade in person, such as shops, venues, clinics and stockists. Founders selling online are welcome too. She also works with shopping centres, venues and destinations.
- Free resource: a one page checklist of seven things a brand should ask its shopping centre for.
- AI: used to do the research, drafting and reporting behind the work, and reviewed by Sinead before anything reaches a client. Unit Check, a written take it or leave it verdict on a retail unit, is coming soon and is not yet open. Sophie is an AI social media agent that plans, writes and schedules posts and reports monthly.

## Evidence from Liffey Valley Shopping Centre

- 10M+ visitors a year
- Footfall grew 20%
- Average visit lengthened from 87 to 98 minutes
- Average spend per visit rose from 88 to 119 euro
- ABC1 share of visitors rose from 62% to 71%
- Part of the team that secured Ireland's first concept Zara store and built a pop up programme for emerging Irish brands
- Hines European ESG Award and BREEAM Outstanding rating
